findings: The `line` element is added as a single fill edge, and the rasterizer treats that edge as a closed fill boundary. A diagonal line can therefore paint a wedge, violating the requirement that lines remain invisible until stroke support. The current fixture and C test use only a horizontal line, which cannot expose this. See `src/svg/shape/shape.c:636` and `src/raster/shape_render.c:45-60`.

Ellipse bounds failures can return success with a destroyed document and no diagnostic. In `ellipse_edges`, an out-of-range generated vertex makes `point_bounded(next)` false and returns without calling `fail`; the decoder’s failure path then returns the still-`NONE` diagnostic category. For example, a small circle centered at the maximum allowed coordinate can reach this path. See `src/svg/shape/shape.c:499-505` and `src/svg/shape/shape.c:687-688`. Add a bounds diagnostic and cover this case.
summary: The supplied deterministic checks support the reported build, sanitizer, fuzz, renderer-comparison, and corpus results; the pending STATE/LEDGER status and preflight-only ledger block are not findings. The two code defects above prevent acceptance.
